Fixture: switching to "accept all" must not reload a reload-on-save host forever

Live report (kpmg.com, 2026-09-06): "although it worked fine at first, when I switch from custom to accept all in the extension, the website keeps reloading forever."

The shape that produces it, reproduced here:

  • A choice has already been recorded (a previous run in custom mode), so the site shows no banner at all — there is no #onetrust-banner-sdk in the DOM and the preference center stays display:none.
  • Because nothing is visible, none of the extension's normal banner-driven paths run. The only thing that does is syncOneTrustConsent()'s silent API resync, which exists precisely so a preference change still applies on a return visit.
  • The site reloads as a side effect of any consent write — kpmg.com does this from its own consent-change handler, not from the OneTrust SDK.

So the resync writes, the site reloads, the fresh page resyncs again, and it never stops. It never trips the loop-breaker in utils/loop-detection.js either, because the silent resync deliberately reports nothing — which is exactly why the user saw an endlessly reloading page rather than an auto-disabled extension.

Correct behaviour: apply the new preference once, then recognise on the next load that the recorded consent already matches and do nothing.
